commits_info.message:
2.26.2 release (previous 2.26.1) + release notes updated by CI build 4040

[ci skip-release]

Merge pull request #1683 from mockito/location-impl-memory-computation

Eagerly compute stackTraceLine in LocationImpl

Remove Gradle sha256sum

Gradle automatically adds this, but it is unreliable on Travis.
Fix CheckStyle warnings and only run memory test if fastpath is supported
Add missing parameter in test stub

Fix some regressions

This also cleans up the handling of stacktraces when using the inline
mockmaker. It will now no longer copy the whole stacktrace, but be
smart and simply skip 1 line.
Flip logic for choosing a stacktraceelement

Add simple test to enforce memory starvation

This test crashes early on release/2.x and runs just fine on this
branch.

Implement fast-path computation for stackTrace filtering

This significantly speeds up average test durations. On one internal
test, before this change it was timing out after 60 seconds. After this
change, it reliably completes within 25 seconds.

Eagerly compute stackTraceLine in LocationImpl

On typical tests with large stacktraces and many invocations on mocks,
the storing of Throwable in `stackTraceHolder` would result in
OutOfMemoryErrors. Eager computation of the stackTraceLine resulted in a
~2/3rd memory reduction of a typical test (1.5GB -> 400MB).
